premises.text: HTML5 and browser stacks have inherent flaws that cannot deliver native-class 3D/2D performance
premises.evidence_span: there are inherent flaws that exist in the browser that make that impossible to do things like this

premises.text: Treat a game engine as an app engine because games already solved 3D/2D performance and apps are just pixels
premises.evidence_span: what if a game engine is an app engine?

premises.text: Bypass inefficient browser layers with a direct mathematical conversation to the GPU on any GPU-accessible OS device
premises.evidence_span: we're having a direct and beautiful mathematical conversation with the GPU

premises.text: Same stack runs across iOS, Android, PC, Mac, and consoles (Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo)
premises.evidence_span: this also runs on iOS, Android. It runs on PCs, and it runs on Macs

premises.text: Gives JavaScript engineers a powerful new tool that can outperform HTML5 and native for rich experiences
premises.evidence_span: this gives JavaScript engineers a new tool in their tool belt that they didn't have before

premises.text: Democratize 3D development like WordPress and bridge 2D↔3D so switching is merely a settings option
premises.evidence_span: we want to democratize the development of the 3D world

domains.name: game engine as app engine with GPU bypass

value.text: Designers and engineers can build native-class 2D/3D experiences in a new world beyond HTML5 limits
value.evidence_span: there is a whole new world out there that you didn't know that existed

secondary_value.text: Order-of-magnitude better tool than HTML5/native for JS web apps
secondary_value.evidence_span: we can change them, not by a little bit, but by an order of magnitude

causal_links.evidence_span: we've got to go into a different direction if we want to do stuff like this
Performance that even a native app would die to have
HTML5 is good, native is better, but famous is the best

notes: HTML5 impossibility as problem. Game-engine=app-engine, GPU bypass, and cross-device run folded as one core invention cascade (§4.1.7). JS engineer tool and WordPress-like 3D democratization/2D bridge kept as GTM/adoption package for who the platform serves. Vision of Flickr/Pinterest/Lucas templates treated as value framing not extra premises (§4.1.4). Beta signup excluded as traction CTA. Three domains.
